seo.title: Putting it together: the six ideas, explained
seo.description: Grow, name, first, tenth, gap, debt. The whole Basics series in one picture, with the tools in your hands and the door open.

beat1.title: It was never six things.
body: Six talks: the engine, the destination, the order, the amount, the room, and the debt. And I said it was never six things. Here's the one thing.
Every one was the same instinct in a different hat: being on purpose with your money instead of leaving it to chance.

Compound interest = money left to grow, on purpose. A goal = money with a name, on purpose. Pay yourself first = protecting a slice, on purpose. Ten percent = a real amount, on purpose. Living on 70 = making room, on purpose. Clearing debt = killing what eats it, on purpose. Six hats. One head. Being deliberate.

beat2.title: Money you direct behaves.
intro: Here's what's true, and almost nobody says it plainly: money you direct behaves; money you don't, leaks. That's the whole lesson. Everything else is detail.
The people who seem good with money aren't smarter, and plenty don't earn more. They decided what their money was for, before it decided for them.
My grandmother Adelaide did everything right and was never shown one of the six. That's why diBoaS exists, and why I made these. This was the conversation she never got. Now you've had it.

beat3.title: The door is open.
intro: Notice what I never did: I never told you what to do. I showed you how it works and handed you the tools, and every time, the number was yours. That doesn't change now.
I'm not going to end by telling you to hurry, or sign up, or that you're missing out. You're not. The math will still be true tomorrow.

Whether you do this with diBoaS or a shoebox, these six ideas are yours now. Free. The tools are right here if you want to run your whole life through them, together. I run diBoaS and I'd love you to use it, but the point was never the app. It was the door. And it's open.

wrap: That's the Basics. Six ideas most people are never told, now told. What you do with them is, and always was, completely up to you.
More talks are coming when you want them. But you already have the part that matters.
